title: Fast, on-device agentic AI with Muse Glimmer on ExecuTorch
gist: A model and its decoding strategy are lowered ahead of time. On NVIDIA cards the export step compiles and autotunes kernels for the detected GPU architecture; on Apple silicon it targets MLX or custom Metal kernels. Speculative decoding is handled inside the exported artifact.
changes: Tuning at export for the device in hand is now in a mainstream runtime, and the result is tied to that chip: the optimum is specific to what you have.
caveats: No continuous batching or cache sharing across sessions yet. No comparison with llama.cpp or mlx-lm, and most results are charts only. The date shown is last-updated.

numbers.metric: Text plus image decode with speculative decoding

bears_on.note: Kernels are compiled and tuned for the GPU it detects, and the result is tied to that chip.

retired_why: Cited by no lever, figure or tension, read second-hand, and its one point, that settings are specific to the chip in hand, is made by measured signals. Retired on the weekly deep pass to stay within the limit on active signals.
